dataset.name: google/fleurs
dataset.selection: First twelve eligible recordings (7–18 s) in first 100 rows; no ASR results used for selection.

protocol.shared_preparation: peak normalized to 0.5, 0.6s leading and 0.8s trailing padding; identical inputs across methods
protocol.rnnoise: FFmpeg arnndn with std.rnnn (original Xiph model), 50% and 100% mixes; 48kHz up/downsampling
protocol.deepfilter: Official macOS arm64 deep-filter v0.5.6, DeepFilterNet3, 12dB attenuation limit, compensated delay
protocol.silero: Official ONNX model; 512-sample frames, thresholds 0.5/0.35, 160ms minimum speech, 300ms silence, 200ms margins
protocol.normalization: Static gain per recording, based on 90th-percentile frame RMS, at most +12dB; not native AGC
protocol.scoring: WER/CER after lowercasing, punctuation removal and whitespace normalization; no semantic/numeral equivalence normalization
protocol.timing: Standalone batch processing including process/model startup; not incremental app latency

whisper.bootstrap_cluster: reference sentence ID; exploratory intervals, small corpus

mai_severe_noise_followup.condition: Synthetic office mixture at 0dB SNR: equal speech and noise power before peak scaling
mai_severe_noise_followup.status: Exploratory follow-up after the primary pilot; reported separately

deepfilter_vad_diagnostic_followup.condition: quiet (-24dB), same 12 recordings as primary pilot
deepfilter_vad_diagnostic_followup.interpretation: Most observed damage in the combined pipeline disappears when the post-denoising energy VAD is removed; this is not evidence that DeepFilter alone universally harms ASR.

nonspeech_api_followup.interpretation: The measured advantage of Silero here is avoiding requests for nonspeech, not a demonstrated reduction in hallucinations.

conclusions: No tested additional filter demonstrated an aggregate WER improvement over the current pipeline in the primary MAI pilot.
Synthetic severe noise did not reverse that result; raw audio had two fewer word errors than current VAD in the 278-word follow-up.

Silero rejected all four synthetic nonspeech samples and no entire speech recording, but changing its trimming also changed ASR outputs. Gate-only use is a next hypothesis, not a separately validated integration.
Do not add DeepFilter followed by the existing energy VAD without resolving their interaction on quiet speech.
limitations: Small pilot, read public speech, only male labels in available selected validation rows; no user microphone or private audio.
Sources are 16kHz. Upsampling for 48kHz denoisers does not recreate native full-band microphone audio.
Noise is synthetic. No real room echo, overlapping talkers, female/child voices or broad accent coverage.
Apple Voice Processing/AEC and true dynamic AGC were not tested; these need a separate capture/reference setup.
Preprocessing variants other than raw and Silero are followed by the existing Hex energy VAD.
Whisper Small results do not establish MAI, GPT Transcribe or Nova performance.
Fixed Portuguese language hint; Auto-detect behavior was not assessed.
Twelve recordings contain eleven distinct reference sentences; exploratory bootstrap groups repeated sentences together.
MAI temperature zero and randomized within-case processing order do not eliminate all service variability.
Small differences of a few words do not establish a statistically reliable general ranking.
